$comment: Pinned build toolchain for the OpenMana Forge engine. engine/scripts/setup-toolchain.sh downloads, verifies and unpacks exactly these archives. Change only in a dedicated toolchain PR (docs/research/FORGE_BUILD.md §3, §6).

graalvm.distribution: Oracle GraalVM (GraalVM Free Terms and Conditions)
graalvm.checksumSource: Computed on the first download (2026-09-24). Oracle publishes no checksum next to this archive URL, so this value is the pin; keep an archived copy of the tarball.

binaryen.checksumSource: binaryen-version_123-x86_64-linux.tar.gz.sha256 published on the GitHub release; matches the download.

maven.checksumSource: apache-maven-3.9.16-bin.tar.gz.sha512 published by Apache; matches the download.

node.note: Node runs the resource packer, the launcher post-processing and the Wasm smoke tests. The smoke tests verify the required Wasm features (GC, exnref, typed function references) instead of assuming them; Node 22.22.3 was measured to run Web Image output without extra flags.
